findings.description: No key_policy is defined for the KMS key, so AWS applies the default key policy granting the entire account's IAM principals (via IAM policies) access to the key. In a regulated audit-trail context, this can allow any sufficiently privileged IAM principal in the account to manage or use the key rather than restricting it to a defined set of least-privilege principals.

The resource does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so automatic annual rotation of the KMS key material is disabled by default, increasing the risk of long-term exposure if key material is ever compromised.
